comment: fix: Restore short-circuit semantics in Vega-Lite expressions and warn and exclude rows when filter evaluation fails. Nonaggregate vertical bar charts without timeUnit render the native no-data display when successful filtering exhausts populated data whose encoded fields validate before the exhausting filter, preserving healthy concat siblings. Empty eligibility is read-only and excludes temporal or aggregate normalization. Execute stacked-bar and line-overlay transforms once per data series, preserving conditional color and temporal preparation on the actual output rows. Empty source data, invalid encoded fields, and filter-error depletion retain strict validation and can throw during rendering. Callers needing containment of invalid child specs must handle render errors externally. Other marks retain their existing empty-data behavior. Filters remain display-only, not authorization controls.
